# WireGuard's embeddable library

`wireguard.c` and `wireguard.h` are WireGuard's own small C library for
configuring a WireGuard interface in the Linux kernel. They are taken unchanged
from `contrib/embeddable-wg-library` in
[wireguard-tools](https://git.zx2c4.com/wireguard-tools/).

file says. Do not edit them here: to update, copy the two files again.
